harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway on its private-network interface (eth1, 10.50.50.254/24) with a source-NAT masquerade rule out eth0 and a default-drop forward filter allowing established/related and eth1-originated traffic. Gave node2 and node3 static addresses on their matching private NIC (enp8s0: 10.50.50.11/24 and 10.50.50.12/24) with a default route via node1, via systemd-networkd drop-in files. Verified via conntrack on node1 that traffic from both nodes is masqueraded to node1's WAN address (10.100.232.10) and reaches the internet (curl bound to the private interface returns 200-series/redirect responses). Then executed the mandatory sequential single-node-restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3 — captured pre-restart boot_id and health, issued a background-acknowledged `reboot`, polled until exec returned, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and re-verified NAT config/connectivity (or private-interface config/connectivity) after each restart before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes' interfaces/routes to discover the private (unaddressed) NIC: eth1 on node1, enp8s0 on node2/node3

Configured VyOS on node1: eth1 address 10.50.50.254/24, NAT source rule 100 masquerading 10.50.50.0/24 out eth0, forward filter default-drop + established/related accept + eth1 accept; committed and saved
Verified ip_forward=1 and per-interface forwarding enabled on node1
Created /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network on node2 (10.50.50.11/24) and node3 (10.50.50.12/24) with a metric-2048 default route via 10.50.50.254; reloaded networkd
Verified connectivity: ping to gateway, curl --interface enp8s0 to https://1.1.1.1 and api.ipify.org from node2/node3
Verified via node1 conntrack -L that flows from 10.50.50.11/.12 are masqueraded to node1's WAN IP 10.100.232.10 before reaching internet hosts
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on node1, node2, node3

Restarted node1 via backgrounded `reboot` (ack returned pre-disconnect), polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed (e98d9010→13aedc4e), verified NAT rule/eth1 address/ip_forward persisted, verified node2/node3 internet access via node1 recovered
Restarted node2, confirmed boot_id changed (cfdbaef8→57181c62), verified enp8s0 static config and internet reachability recovered
Restarted node3, confirmed boot_id changed (96c08b66→aa5a56bb), verified enp8s0 static config and internet reachability recovered
Final conntrack check on node1 confirming both node2 and node3 traffic is currently NATed post full restart cycle

evidence.requirement: node1 configured with NAT (source masquerade) enabling node2/node3 to reach internet
evidence.summary: VyOS eth1 addressed 10.50.50.254/24, NAT source rule 100 masquerading 10.50.50.0/24 via eth0 committed/saved, forward filter confirmed

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 given addresses on the private network with route via node1
evidence.summary: systemd-networkd static config applied: node2=10.50.50.11/24, node3=10.50.50.12/24, both with default route via 10.50.50.254

evidence.requirement: processes on node2/node3 can actually reach the internet through node1
evidence.summary: curl bound to private interface succeeds from both nodes; node1 conntrack shows masqueraded flows (src 10.50.50.11/.12 -> translated to 10.100.232.10) reaching internet destinations

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered NAT state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e98d9010 and NAT/eth1 config captured; reboot acked; connection dropped then returned; boot_id changed to 13aedc4e; NAT rule, eth1 address, ip_forward confirmed intact; node2/node3 internet access via node1 verified working post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered connectivity
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cfdbaef8 and working enp8s0 config captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to 57181c62; enp8s0 static IP/route and internet reachability confirmed post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered connectivity
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96c08b66 and working enp8s0 config captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to aa5a56bb; enp8s0 static IP/route and internet reachability confirmed post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart-cycle final proof NAT is functioning for both node2 and node3 simultaneously
evidence.summary: conntrack on node1 shows current masqueraded TCP flows from both 10.50.50.11 and 10.50.50.12 to 1.1.1.1 translated to node1's WAN IP, after all three sequential restarts completed
